research.title: RAG-RST: Retrieved Exemplars as In-Context Discourse Schema for RST Parsing
research.snippet: In Rhetorical Structure Theory (RST), each edge of a discourse tree carries a nuclearity label, marking which span holds the central content, and a relation drawn from a closed inventory of functional categories.
